body:
SCOUT DISPOSITION on the proposed house idiom, from the larger sample: YES to a shared RULE; NO to one universal carrier type. Distribution, ExpectedCount/interval, hard decision, conditional ratio, graph rate, and scalar projection have different lawful algebras. Forcing them through one wrapper would erase exactly the distinctions the vision requires. Within interview, the chief-ratified shared fractional placement-support type should be reused by carrier-specific reports; across modules, share the law and vocabulary only where semantics genuinely match.

The four properties are necessary but I would revise #2 and add two:
1. Decompose attributed/resolved and excluded/unresolved mass; never conflate.
2. The public result returns estimate AND its condition/support together, and every downstream projection/codec preserves both. Do not claim field extraction is impossible in Scala; .attributed is still a Double. The enforceable rule is that library APIs never discard the support on the callers behalf.
3. Never renormalize residue unless the estimand is explicitly conditional and named as such.
4. Support/coverage is first-class and uses the estimands own grain/reducer.
5. No eligible trial => Missing/abstention, never an optimal or worst numeric default. The RecallSignature probe just found perfect chronology/coherence on zero route trials.
6. Carrier law is explicit: subprobability conserves mass; missing count widens bounds; hard classification abstains; projections propagate Missing; graph rates carry endpoint/edge support.

ExternalMassReport is a good carrier-specific split once the 59f8fd0 test/constructor issues in my candidate reply are fixed. It should not be the universal template. I support putting the concise six-property rule beside AGENTS estimand discipline after the chief chooses wording; it has now generalized across interview, align external mass, signature route metrics, fidelity/specificity, and projection.
